sentencing.text: She introduced legislation creating alternatives to incarceration for low-level, nonviolent theft offenses.
sentencing.quote: Create alternatives to jail for low-level, nonviolent theft offenses

guns.text: Her campaign pledges legislation against gun violence and efforts to remove illegally possessed guns.
guns.quote: Continue to lead against gun violence; get illegal guns off the streets, and champion legislation that addresses systemic issues contributing to gun violence.

abortion.text: Her campaign states that she will protect women’s ability to make their own health-care decisions.
abortion.quote: LaShae will ensure California stays on the leading edge of protecting a woman’s right to make her own health care decisions.

energy.text: Her campaign calls for reducing greenhouse-gas emissions and providing 100% clean energy.
energy.quote: Build a more sustainable California by reducing greenhouse gas emissions, providing 100% clean energy, and ensuring that all communities have access to clean air, and water, and fight for stronger animal welfare, protect California's wildlife, and continue to make California a leader in the fight against climate change.

tax.text: Lawson says he will oppose rising state fees and taxes while reducing regulatory burdens on small businesses.
tax.quote: Andrew will fight to reduce the burden on small businesses, oppose job-killing mandates, and protect taxpayers from Sacramento’s ever-increasing fees and taxes.

housing.text: Lawson supports streamlining permits, reducing regulatory barriers, and incentivizing construction of affordable housing.
housing.quote: Andrew Lawson believes in cutting bureaucratic red tape that delays new construction, streamlining the permitting process, and incentivizing builders to create housing that working families can actually afford.

schools.text: Lawson supports school choice and directing more education funding to classrooms rather than administration.
schools.quote: Andrew supports empowering parents with school choice, raising academic standards, ensuring transparency in curricula, and directing funding to classrooms instead of administrative overhead.

safety.text: Lawson supports fully funding law enforcement and reversing policies he characterizes as soft on crime.
safety.quote: Andrew supports fully funding law enforcement, reversing soft-on-crime policies that have emboldened repeat offenders, and ensuring that the justice system fulfills its responsibility to uphold the law and protect public safety.
